home.title: World Timezone Comparison
home.description: Compare time zones across the world. Find optimal meeting times for your global team.
home.loginPrompt: Login to save your timezone presets and business hours

cityPair.description2: Current time difference between {city1} ({country1}) and {city2} ({country2}). Compare time zones and find optimal meeting times.
cityPair.description3: Compare current times and time differences between {city1}, {city2}, and {city3}. Find the best meeting times across all three time zones.
cityPair.subtitle2: Current local times and time zone offset between {city1} and {city2}.
cityPair.subtitle3: Current local times and time zone comparison for {cities}.
cityPair.gridLegend: Green rows = business hours (9 AM–5 PM) in all cities. Amber rows = business hours in some cities.
cityPair.planMeetings: Plan meetings across any time zone
cityPair.planMeetingsDesc: Use Timezone Harmony to compare multiple cities interactively, set a specific meeting time, and export events to your calendar.
cityPair.scheduleMeetingDesc: Pick any time slot and export it to your calendar.
cityPair.faqQ1: What are the current UTC offsets for {cities}?
cityPair.faqA1: {offsets}. These offsets may shift by ±1 hour during daylight saving time transitions.
cityPair.faqQ2: Does daylight saving time affect the time difference?
cityPair.faqA2: Yes. Countries that observe daylight saving time shift their clocks by 1 hour, which changes the time difference between cities. This page automatically reflects the current offset and is updated hourly.
